Name: Eugene for Mobile Phone Mod
Author: Pandappuccino
Description:
So I absolutely adore [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9222]Eugene[/url], he's probably my favorite custom NPC thus far and I'm so happy that he's 1.6-compatible now.  However, being a custom NPC, he's missing data to let players call him using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone[/url] mod, and generic greeting keys are kind of dull when you have options to change it.  So, I decided that for a quick and simple mod, I'd add his events to the mod myself for my own use--and I'd share it with others who use the mod as well!

The event names are as spoiler-free as I could make them for the menu while still cluing into which event it references--thankfully, since you have to see them in-game to access them in the menu, this should only be a problem if you're looking into the files.  By default, Eugene requires 250 points (1 heart) to be able to call him; you can edit this in [b]content.json[/b] at the line "minPointsToCall"!

Mods used in screenshots:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14848]Alternate Portraits for Eugene[/url]﻿ by AirynS
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7390]Mobile Phone Reskin[/url]﻿ by SilentResident
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Adds custom greetings and event reminiscence for Eugene to the Mobile Phone mod.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Eugene for Mobile Phone
Manifest.Description: An add-on for aedenthorn's (now updated and maintained by JoXW) Mobile Phone mod. Adds mobile phone greetings and farewells for Eugene (NPC by irias0701, English translation by Sapiescent).
